stem: A portable fan has a damaged guard that allows fingers to reach moving blades. Which statement is strongest?
choices: The fan is acceptable if workers are careful
The fan should be removed from normal use until the guarding condition is corrected through the approved process
The guard matters only at maximum speed
The damage can be ignored if the fan is above waist height
rationale: Damaged machine guarding creates direct contact risk. Reliance on caution does not replace the required equipment control.
